jobs.description:
Work as an Outbound Warehouse Employee in Eindhoven at DHL and help ensure that thousands of orders are shipped on time. In the outbound department, you will work together with an enthusiastic team to keep the logistics process running smoothly. In return for your efforts, you will receive a gross hourly wage of €15.12, shift allowance, travel reimbursement and the opportunity to obtain a contract with DHL. Would you like to work in a modern distribution centre with plenty of opportunities to develop yourself? Apply today.

Your responsibilities include:

    - Collecting orders using a handheld scanner
    
- Checking and processing products
    
- Packing customer orders
    
- Preparing orders for shipment
    
- Performing quality checks
    
- Carrying out internal transport activities
    
- Operating a reach truck or HHOV (if certified)

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15,12 per hour
    
- 35% shift allowance after 21:00
    
- Travel reimbursement up to €14.85 per day
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower with the opportunity to obtain a contract with DHL
    
- Free access to more than 200 online training courses through the Manpower Academy

    - At least 18 years old due to the nature of the work
    
- Available to work 40 hours per week
    
- Own transportation to travel to the work location
    
- Good command of the Dutch and/or English language
    
- Willingness to perform physical work
    
- Ability to apply for a Certificate of Conduct (VOG)

Are you ready to start working as an Outbound Warehouse Employee in Eindhoven at DHL? Don't wait too long. There is currently room for new colleagues, but the number of available positions is limited. Click the apply button and we will contact you as soon as possible.

Fixed hours, a predictable schedule, and room to grow if you want to. Apply now and start as a Warehouse Employee this week. You work across different departments in a warehouse in Wijchen, where correctly labeling goods is your main responsibility. On receiving, you immediately give all incoming products the right identification labels and process them in the system. You work in a fixed shift, but carry out these labeling tasks completely independently. Each hall has its own products and specific labeling procedures, and you switch smoothly between them.

We expect the following of a Warehouse Employee:  - Good command of Dutch or English
 - Available on short notice
 - Willing to obtain your EPT certificate (costs are covered)
 
 You work accurately, adapt easily, and handle variety well. You take your tasks seriously and work well with the people around you.

- You have strong organizational and analytical skills with an eye for detail.
